   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Sep 12, 2026 - Sep 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Asdflpi_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "Please fix this bug… I watched an ad to claim a reward, but there’s no button to leave the ad. I have to quit the app and re-enter, but can’t claim the reward. The ad is way too long and keeps inducing user to download games, which is pretty distracting for an app meant to help users lock in… Look, I’ve been using this for almost a year now, the old version is really sweet and cute, and it really helps me a lot. But the new updates are just so premium and ad focused that the whole page looked filled and messy. All gifts can only be claimed with ad, and btw I can’t get out of ANY of them."
            2. _Person of pure honesty_, Sep 30, 2026, 2/5: "Very good but constant updates that are really annoying and bug the whole app. NO MORE UPDATES"
            3. _Kad2011_, Sep 30, 2026, 3/5: "I actually LOVE this app. I found it this week and I’d already had so much more focus when using it, but it drains my battery so much. I did a 40min focus session and it drained my battery by 20% and my phone is getting really hot. I thought it may have just been my phone, but my friend who recommended it is getting the same issue so we’re going to stop using sadly 💔"
